title: Page 2
content_zh:
但恰在此时丁锦绣怀孕了，却因为怀孕期间依然婆媳不和，再加上看着丈夫的两个小妻争风吃醋，心中烦闷，身体越来越差，到最后难产，拚着自己送命，保住了儿子。

谢雍在嫡妻去世之后，至今已经五年，身边的人都极力劝他续弦，一个大男人没有一个正经的妻室主持内闱，终究不方便，日常生活且不说，就连人情礼往都不方便，他总不能让小妾出头露面吧？那还不把人家那些正妻给得罪光？筒直太着不起人了。

身为连中三元的大才子、京城新贵、皇帝眼中的红人，谢雍虽然是续弦再娶，依然炙手可热，登门说亲的媒婆几乎络绎不绝，但是谁也没想到，万分挑剔的谢雍最后居然选中了京城最着名的‘扫把星’——原宜之。

原宜之出身豪门世家不假，想与原府攀上亲戚的人很多，这也不假，但是原宜之的命格实在太凶了，接连议亲三次都克死未婚夫，谁还敢拿自家的小命开玩笑？

所以谢雍一说要到原府提亲，立刻一堆人反对，不仅他的寡母极力抗拒，就连亲威朋友都劝他莫要胡闹，万一被克死可不是好玩的。

谢雍却道：“大家说她克夫，算命先生也说我命硬克妻呢，这样说来，我们可不是天生一对？”

原府主母郑氏亲自拿着谢雍与原宜之的八字，请了皇家钦天监的监正合八字，倒是正如谢雍所说，两人八字极为相合，的的确确是天造地设的一对佳偶。

至此，谢雍与原宜之的婚事才议妥，最终成就了这桩姻缘。

四个大丫鬟伺候着原宜之沐浴梳冼，换上了内室穿的便装，因为是大婚之喜，自然还是大红色的。

一切收拾妥当，知微又命小丫鬟送上来热呼呼的饭食，原宜之吃了一点，便推说饱了，实际上是她没什么胃口。

原宜之真没想到自己亥能有这样出嫁成亲的一天，而且夫婿据说还是人中龙凤，诸多人羡慕。

接连三次议亲失败后，原宜之都认为自己命不好克夫了，她曾经很认真地劝说父母，莫要再为她的婚事伤神，命不好她认了，父母在时她就在父母跟前尽孝，父母百年之后，她就剃了头发去做尼姑，清清白白一辈子，也不算不好吧？

谁会想到，会有一位才华卓着的状元郎向她提亲呢？

到现在，原宜之都有些如在梦中，她觉得不可思议，也曾暗中猜测谢雍是否为了攀附原府而提亲，可是她后来仔细了解了谢雍的情况后才知道，谢雍其实很得圣心，根本不需要攀附任何权贵。

谢雍当年连中三元后，就进入翰林院做了修撰，从六品，官职算高，而且三年后直接进入户部，一跃成为户部郎中，正五品，一下子官升三级，羡煞多少人。

而且谢雍很得当今皇帝玄昱的青睐，经常宣召他单独觐见，这是难得的圣恩，明眼人都知道谢雍的未来前程不可限量，所以他虽然只是户部的附属官，他的顶头上司户部尚书也对他极为客气。

综合各种消息，原宜之倒搞不清楚谢雍为何选中她做继室了？

难道他就不怕她‘克夫’的名声？不怕她给他带来恶运？

所以，原宜之出嫁的心态极为复杂，一半确实是新嫁娘的欣喜与对未来婚姻生活的美好憧憬；另一大半却是忐忑不安与各种担忧；担忧自己会给夫婿带来恶运、担忧自己无法讨得婆婆的欢心、担忧无法做好继母等等。

天色渐渐暗沉下来，前庭的喧嚣声已经弱了许多，原宜之猜谢雍应该快回来了，不由更是心头小鹿乱撞，越发紧张起来。

和烟看得出小姐的异样，便体贴地靠近她，为她揉捏着僵硬的肩膀和手臂，在她耳边悄声道：“小姐且放宽心，奴婢觉得姑爷虽然看起来严肃古板，可是目光温和，又体贴小姐，刚才不就把那些看热闹的闲杂人等赶出去了吗？想来不会难相处的，而且奴婢听人说，男人年纪大了会体贴女人，小姐以后一定会苦尽甘来，等着享清福呢。”

原宜之笑了一下，她也希望如此，在娘家看到了大哥和大嫂鹣鲽情深，看到了二哥对冲喜的小妻苏抹徽百般呵护，她又何尝不希望遇到良人，夫妻二人恩爱携手百年呢？

可是这谢家，据说上头有个极为厉害的婆婆，下头又有个身体孱弱的嫡子，中间还有两个千娇百媚的小妾，这日子真的能过得顺心如意吗？

原宜之很想叹气，可是大喜之日，叹气不吉利，她也只好强行压制下去，保持着脸上温柔的笑意。

第1章(2)

就在原宜之忐忑紧张地等待着夫君回来时，洞房帘子外有人喊道：“启禀夫人，老夫人不好了，请夫人前去照看。”

原宜之吃了一惊，急忙站起来，问道：“婆婆怎么了？可要紧？”

外面传话的小丫鬟道：“老夫人最近一直为了婚事忙碌，虽然身体不好也强撑着，今儿个夫人进门，老夫人太开心了就多喝了两杯，谁知道犯了眩晕的老毛病，而且比以前越发厉害呢。”

在听着小丫鬟回话的时候，和烟已经为原宜之准备好了外出的衣裳，和霞又取来了大红羽缎披风为原宜之穿戴好。

原宜之跟随着小丫鬟出了房门，问道：“可请了大夫？”

小丫鬟道：“知彰哥哥拿了老爷的印信去请太医了。”

原宜之点点头，谢雍很得皇帝青睐，谢家能请得动太医也是能理解的。

和烟与和霞却在后面彼此对望使眼色，两个大丫鬟都觉得此事蹊跷，而且老夫人行事明显不妥当，就算她身体略有不适，真的就严重到需要把新娘子从新房里叫到她跟前伺候？

这也太不尊重新娘子了吧？把新娘子一辈子一次的美好洞房花烛夜当成了什么？故意搞破坏吗？

看那小丫鬟口齿伶俐的模样，一点也没有焦虑之色，明显老夫人病不重，根本就是不安好心吧？

和霞忍不住问道：“不知这位姐姐如何称呼？”

小丫鬟道：“不敢当，奴婢甘草，不过是老夫人跟前专管跑腿的小丫鬟。”

和霞笑道：“甘草姐姐，老夫人病倒了，可叫了姑爷，啊不，可叫了老爷过去伺候？”

甘草怔了一下，回头看了和霞一眼，目光中带了审视，却笑着回道：“老爷在前庭招待贵宾，老夫人吩咐了不许打扰他，万一得罪了贵客就不好了。”

和霞对和烟眨眨眼，扁了扁嘴，却没有再说话。

很明显，老夫人这是故意折腾她们小姐呢！

新婚之夜，居然还把新娘子从洞房里叫出来伺候婆婆，太过分了！

和霞握了握小拳头，心里忿忿不平。

原宜之的神色倒是淡然，她预料到谢母一定极为厌恶自己这个‘扫把星’做她的儿媳，进门后大概会刁难她，只是没想到谢母如此沉不住气，洞房之夜就迫不及待要给她一个下马威了。

谢母的院子松鹤园是谢府中最大的一座，雍容静穆，端庄气派。

金陵谢府的府门牌匾上‘状元府’那三个子可是当今皇帝玄昱御笔亲书，府邸也是皇帝御赐给谢雍的，已经过户给谢家，变成谢家的私产，而不再是官府踢给大臣的普通宅邸。

有些得势的大臣也会得到皇帝恩踢的宅邸，但是这种宅子的归属权还是属于官府，一旦在佳的官员去世或者贬职、离职等，宅邸就会被官府收回，官员的家眷往往会被迫返回老家，不然在京城连个落脚之地部会没有。
content_en:
But at this time, Ding Jinxiu became pregnant. However, due to the quarrel between her mother-in-law and daughter-in-law during the pregnancy, and the jealousy of her husband's two wives, she felt depressed and her health became worse and worse. In the end, she had difficulty giving birth, and she risked her own life to save her son.

It has been five years since Xie Yong's first wife passed away. People around him have tried their best to persuade him to renew his relationship. It is inconvenient for a grown man to not have a decent wife to take charge of his house. Not to mention daily life, even the exchange of favors and courtesy is inconvenient. He can't let his concubine show up in public, right?Why don't you offend all the wives?Tsurugi is so impressive.

As a talented man who won three yuan in a row, an upstart in the capital, and a popular person in the eyes of the emperor, Xie Yong was still very popular even though he was remarrying. There was almost an endless stream of matchmakers who came to propose marriage. However, no one expected that the extremely picky Xie Yong finally chose the most famous 'broom star' in the capital - Yuan Yizhi.

It is true that Yuan Yizhi came from a wealthy family, and there are many people who want to be related to the Yuan family. This is true, but Yuan Yizhi's fate is so unlucky. He tried to marry his fiancé three times in a row, but his fiancé was killed. Who dares to joke about his own life?

So as soon as Xie Yong said that he wanted to go to Yuan Mansion to propose marriage, a lot of people immediately opposed it. Not only his widowed mother strongly resisted, but even relatives and friends advised him not to mess around, as it would not be fun if he was killed.

Xie Yong said: "Everyone says that she is destined to defeat her husband, and the fortune teller also says that my destiny is to defeat my wife. So, are we not meant to be a match?"

Mrs. Zheng, the mistress of the original palace, personally took the horoscopes of Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi and asked Jian Zheng of the Royal Qintian Prison to combine their horoscopes. As Xie Yong said, the two people's horoscopes were very similar, and they were indeed a match made in heaven.

At this point, Xie Yong and Yuan Yizhi's marriage was finally settled, and the marriage was finally achieved.

The four maids took care of Yuan Yizhi's bathing and combing, and changed into the casual clothes worn in the inner room. Since it was a wedding, they were naturally in bright red.

After everything was put away, Zhiwei ordered the little maid to bring hot food. Yuan Yizhi ate a little and then said she was full, but in fact she had no appetite.

Yuan Yizhizhen never thought that he would be able to get married one day, and his husband was said to be the best among men, and many people envied him.

After three consecutive marriage proposals failed, Yuan Yizhi thought that she was destined to be a nun. She once seriously persuaded her parents not to worry about her marriage anymore. She accepted that her fate was bad. She would be filial to her parents when they were alive. A hundred years after her parents, she shaved her head and became a nun. She would be innocent for the rest of her life. Isn't that not bad?

Who would have thought that a talented scholar would propose marriage to her?

Until now, Yuan Yizhi felt a bit like she was in a dream. She found it unbelievable. She also secretly speculated whether Xie Yong proposed marriage in order to cling to the Yuan Mansion. However, after carefully understanding Xie Yong's situation, she realized that Xie Yong actually had the Sacred Heart and did not need to cling to any powerful people.

After Xie Yong won three yuan in a row, he entered the Hanlin Academy to do compilation. He was promoted from the sixth rank to a high-ranking official. Three years later, he directly entered the Ministry of Household Affairs and became a doctor in the Ministry of Household Affairs.

Moreover, Xie Yong was very favored by the current emperor Xuan Yu, who often summoned him to see him alone. This was a rare divine grace. Anyone with a discerning eye knew that Xie Yong's future was limitless. Therefore, although he was only an affiliated official of the Ministry of Hubu, his immediate superior, the Minister of Hubu, was also extremely polite to him.

Based on all the news, Yuan Yizhi couldn't figure out why Xie Yong chose her as his stepmother?

Isn't he afraid of her reputation as a "kefu"?Aren't you afraid that she will bring bad luck to him?

Therefore, Yuan Yizhi's mentality when getting married is extremely complicated. Half of it is the joy of the newlyweds and the beautiful longing for the future married life; the other half is uneasiness and various worries; worried that she will bring bad luck to her husband, worried that she will not be able to please her mother-in-law, worried that she will not be a good stepmother, etc.

The sky gradually darkened, and the noise in the front yard became much weaker. Yuan Yizhi guessed that Xie Yong would be coming back soon, and couldn't help but feel his heart pounding and become more and more nervous.

He Yan could see the strangeness in the young lady, so he approached her considerately, kneaded her stiff shoulders and arms, and whispered in her ear: "Miss, please relax. I feel that although my uncle looks serious and old-fashioned, his eyes are gentle and considerate.Miss Tie, didn’t you just kick out those idle people watching the fun?I think it won’t be difficult to get along with you, and I heard that men will be considerate to women when they get older, and the miss will definitely have a happy life in the future."

Yuan Yizhi smiled, she also hoped so. She saw the deep love between her eldest brother and her eldest sister-in-law at her parents' home, and saw the second brother's love for his wife Su Mohui. How could she not hope to meet her beloved, and the couple would love each other for hundreds of years?

But this Xie family is said to have an extremely powerful mother-in-law at the top, a frail legitimate son at the bottom, and two charming concubines in the middle. Can they really live a happy life?

Yuan Yizhi wanted to sigh, but on the big day, sighing was unlucky, so she had to suppress it and keep the gentle smile on her face.

Chapter 1(2)

Just as Yuan Yizhi was nervously waiting for her husband to come back, someone outside the curtain of the wedding room shouted: "Madam Qi, the old lady is not well, please go and take care of her."

Yuan Yizhi was taken aback, stood up hurriedly, and asked, "What's wrong with mother-in-law? Is it important?"

The little maid who sent the message outside said: "The old lady has been busy with the wedding recently. Although she is not in good health, she is holding on. Today, the lady came in. The old lady was so happy that she drank two more drinks. Who knew she had the old problem of dizziness, and it is getting worse than before."

While listening to the little maid's reply, He Yan had already prepared clothes for Yuan Yizhi to go out, and He Xia brought a bright red feather satin cloak and put it on for Yuan Yizhi.

Yuan Yizhi followed the little maid out of the room and asked, "Can we invite the doctor?"

The little maid said: "Brother Zhizhang took the master's seal and went to ask the imperial doctor."

Yuan Yizhi nodded. Xie Yong was very favored by the emperor. It was understandable that the Xie family could hire an imperial doctor.

However, He Yan and He Xia looked at each other and winked from behind. Both maids felt that this matter was strange, and the old lady was obviously acting inappropriately. Even if she was slightly unwell, was it really serious enough to call the bride from the bridal chamber to serve her?

Isn’t this too disrespectful to the bride?What do you think of the bride's once-in-a-lifetime beautiful wedding night?Intentional destruction?

Judging from the eloquent appearance of the little maid, there is no sign of anxiety at all. It is obvious that the old lady is not seriously ill, but she is simply uneasy and well-intentioned, right?

He Xia couldn't help but ask: "I wonder what I call this sister?"

The little maid said: "I don't dare to take it as my slave. Licorice is just the little maid who runs errands for the old lady."

He Xia smiled and said, "Sister Licorice, the old lady fell ill. Did you call my uncle? Oh no, did you ask me to come over and take care of you?"

Licorice was startled for a moment, then looked back at He Xia, with scrutiny in her eyes, but she replied with a smile: "The master is entertaining distinguished guests in the front yard, and the old lady has told him not to disturb him. It would be bad if he offends the distinguished guests."

He Xia blinked at He Yan, flattened his mouth, but said no more.

It was obvious that the old lady was deliberately torturing their young lady!

On the wedding night, he actually called the bride out of the bridal chamber to serve her mother-in-law. It was too much!

He Xia clenched her fists, feeling resentful.

Yuan Yizhi's expression was indifferent. She expected that Xie's mother would be extremely disgusted with her being her daughter-in-law, and would probably make things difficult for her after entering the house. However, she didn't expect that Xie's mother would be so impatient that she couldn't wait to give her a showdown on the night of the wedding.

Xie's mother's courtyard, Songhe Garden, is the largest in Xie's mansion. It is graceful, quiet and dignified.

The three sons who read "Zhuangyuan Mansion" on the plaque on the door of Xie Mansion in Jinling are personally written by the current emperor Xuan Yu, and the mansion was also given to Xie Yong by the emperor. It has been transferred to the Xie family and has become the private property of the Xie family, instead of being an ordinary residence given to ministers by the government.

Some powerful ministers would also get mansions favored by the emperor, but the ownership of such houses still belonged to the government. Once a good official died, was demoted, resigned, etc., the mansion would be taken back by the government, and the officials' family members would often be forced to return to their hometowns, otherwise they would not even have a place to stay in the capital.
